title: Modification of Article VI, Chapter 2
previewText: The provisions of Sections 62-52 (Applicability of Waterfront Public Access Area Requirements) and 62-60 (DESIGN REQUIREMENTS FOR WATERFRONT PUBLIC ACCESS AREAS) are modified as set forth in Section 125-46 (Newtown Creek Waterfront Access Plan).
